propositions: code_health lens must compute real values for both Python and non-Python (Go/TypeScript) client projects when external analyzers (scc, jscpd, npx, lizard) are available.
code_health lens must report Unavailable without crashing or fabricating data when metrics extra and external tools are absent.
Integration tests must be gated on tool availability (skip-if-absent) so CI passes without tools and runs real paths when tools are provisioned.
agent_process and git-delta metrics must compute correctly for both languages across analyzer-present and analyzer-absent states.
Fixtures must initialize with committed Python and TypeScript code, create exactly one task, and claim it, producing deterministic churn and first-pass-rate values for oracle validation.
